verdict_reason: Present PE 18.12 sits above own 16yr median (15.41) and avg (16.07) while NPL is rising (2.62% -> 3.53% YoY) -- paying a premium for deteriorating asset quality.
devils_advocate: SBL just raised Rs 3.5bn AT1 capital (PNCPS) mid-year -- market may be pricing in future loan-book growth headroom the trailing EPS doesn't show yet, which would justify a structural re-rating above its old history. Counter to that: NPL is moving the wrong direction at the same time, so the premium could equally be complacency rather than forward-looking capital deployment.
